input.env: Solo E0 Aglaea vs a dummy Elite (atk 150 so she survives 8 cycles; Lightning weakness, 600 Toughness), 8 cycles. energyStartFrac 1 makes the very first action the full-energy Ultimate 'Dance, Destined Weaveress' (140203): it summons Garmentmaker, enters Supreme Stance, starts the SPD-100 Supreme countdown and immediately performs the Joint ATK 'Slash by a Thousandfold Kiss' (140208). While Supreme Stance lasts (countdown 100 AV, Aglaea SPD 250 so she outruns it) every action is another Joint ATK; when the countdown hits, Garmentmaker self-destructs (+20 Energy via 'Bloom of Drying Grass'). Afterwards the rotation cycles Skill 'Rise, Exalted Renown' (140202; re-summon path grants an immediate extra action) and Basic 'Thorned Nectar' (140201; re-applies each attack), Garmentmaker occasionally acts alone with memosprite skill 'Thorned Snare' (1140201), and a second full Ultimate resets the Supreme countdown. Verifies E0 kits: no E1 energy trickle, no E2 DEF-ignore stacks, no E6 RES PEN.
